site_name: Flat 6, Lansdowne House, Lansdowne Road, LONDON, W11 3LP
description: Internal alterations including removal of modern kitchen and relocation to dining platform area; reconfiguration of storage area to utility room; creation of study and separate WC in kitchen; installation of partition to create WC accessed via hallway; installation of partition to separate staircase from main reception room reusing existing door relocated to the plane of the door to living room; formation of fire screen to maintain 30minutes minimum fire separation to mezzanine bedrooms; relocation of door for master bedroom to top of the stairs; alterations to allow two ensuites to be formed in master en suite location; alterations in main bathroom to create storage space within bedroom 2 and to allow for upgrade of facilities; and alteration to terrace access from bedroom 2 (Listed Building Consent only)
